title: Shared definitions
description: Types reused across every entity. Nothing here is an entity in its own right.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Stable for the life of the record — renaming one breaks saved student plans.

intake.description: The admission cycle an Opportunity begins in, e.g. 2027-autumn.

applicantGroup.description: Who a rule applies to. 'any' means the rule does not vary by group.

state.description: Whether this site's reader — an IB Diploma candidate in Denmark, on an EU passport — can take this route or act on this date. 'closed' means they cannot, and the entry must never render as something to act on. 'conditional' means only under a condition the reason names. 'open' is an explicit finding, for a route that sits beside a closed one.

reason.description: One sentence, rendered first. Says why, not what the route is.

readerAccess.description: Whether the reader is eligible at all, as a field rather than a sentence in notes (#35). Distinct from applicantGroup, which says which fee or rule group a date is for, not whether the reader is excluded. On an Application Route it applies to every round and milestone unless one declares its own.

verificationState.description: Our confidence that the evidence is current and supports the claim. Not a claim about truth.

coordinatePrecision.description: How precisely the coordinates locate the thing. A city-centre fallback must never be drawn as an exact campus.

danishLevel.description: Danish upper-secondary subject level. A is highest. These are levels of study, not grades. This is a real scale and the name is accurate, so it stays — but nothing generic may refer to it. A requirement names its scale in `levelScale` and the scale is defined by a Recognition Scheme; see docs/adr/0002-the-ib-scale-is-the-lingua-franca.md.

consequence.description: What actually happens if a milestone is missed. 'hard' means the door closes.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to an Evidence record id.

evidenceRefs.description: Every consequential claim should carry at least one.

institutionRefs.description: The institutions a date belongs to, by the id their page answers to: a canonical Institution id ("dk-sdu") or a country-profile school key ("ca-ubc"). Present on a date that is one or a few schools' own, on a route or in a profile several schools share. A school's page shows such a date only when its id is listed; the name in the label is never guessed at. src/lib/school-dates.mjs reads it; scripts/test-calendar.mjs checks every id resolves to a page.

institutionNames.description: The institutions a date belongs to that have no page on the site, by the name they go by ("Reykjavik University"). A date that carries it and no `institutions` reaches no school page: it stays on the Deadlines page for its country. src/lib/school-dates.mjs reads it, and also counts these names among the institutions a label can name; scripts/test-calendar.mjs requires it on every dated label that names an institution without a page.

yearUnpublished.description: True when the cited source gives the day and month but no year ("15 January"), so the year is inferred from the intake. Such a date must be `provisional`; scripts/test-calendar.mjs checks the two agree and that a note saying "no year" carries this flag.

numerusFixusOnly.description: True for a date that concerns only numerus fixus programmes (a national fixus closing date, ranking numbers). A Programme page whose opportunity records `admission.numerusFixus: false`, and a school page whose every listed programme does, leaves it out (src/lib/school-dates.mjs).

localisedText.description: Official wording kept verbatim alongside a plain-English rendering.

official.description: True when this is the source's exact wording.
